Disappointing Special Occasion
Aug 2026 • Family
Here’s a more formal version:

Disappointing Experience for a Special Occasion

My daughter, traveling from the United States, arranged a birthday package for me as a surprise while I was traveling through Southeast Asia. Regrettably, the experience did not reflect what was arranged or paid for, and several aspects raised genuine concerns.

The restaurant’s interior did not match the photographs advertised online; the mirrored walls were visibly dirty and smudged, detracting significantly from the ambiance. More importantly, the birthday package my daughter had arranged and paid for was never provided, despite the charge appearing on the bill. This was made more apparent by the fact that a neighboring table had received the exact package my daughter had selected. In place of what was ordered, we were served a chocolate mousse cake that was not the one requested.

Of greater concern was an allergy safety issue. I informed staff of a severe, life-threatening sesame allergy. Due to a significant language barrier, this information did not appear to register, and breadsticks containing sesame were brought to our table regardless. When I attempted to clarify the severity of the allergy, a staff member gestured toward my son and said, “he eat,” rather than addressing the concern. This is a serious lapse for any establishment serving food to the public.

Regarding the meal itself: the angus beef and mushroom soup and the chicken Caesar salad were both well prepared, though the lamb chops I ordered were excessively fatty. Staff were courteous throughout, though the language barrier limited their ability to resolve these issues effectively.

I want to acknowledge the effort and thoughtfulness behind my daughter’s gesture — arranging this from abroad for what was the first birthday of mine she could not attend in person. It is unfortunate that the restaurant did not honor the arrangements she made, and I would strongly encourage the establishment to review both its food safety protocols regarding allergens and its fulfillment of pre-paid packages.

If you’re staying at this hotel and you’re looking for conveniency, it’s ok. But, for a fine dining experience or special occasion, I’d pass

Dear Althea J,

After carefully reviewing the situation with our restaurant team, we would like to sincerely clarify what happened regarding your reservation yesterday.

As requested in your reservation, our team had prepared and decorated a table especially for your mother, including a birthday cake, roses, and a tablecloth.

However, at the same time, we had another reservation at the table right next to it with a very similar arrangement. Unfortunately, due to a mistake during the service process, our server mistakenly escorted your mother to the wrong table.

We completely understand that although the table where your mother was seated was also decorated with a birthday sign, candles, and a flower arrangement to create a beautiful setting, it was not the table that had been specifically prepared according to your original request. In particular, the table intended for your mother had roses and a tablecloth, while the table she was seated at did not have these details.

This mix-up also resulted in a difference in the presentation of the birthday cake. Although the cake provided yesterday was actually of a higher value than the one originally selected, we fully understand that what matters is not simply the value of the cake, but also the experience and attention to detail that you expected for such a special occasion with your family.

This was a mistake on our side, and we sincerely apologize to you and your family for the confusion, inconvenience, and disappointing experience caused.

Once again, we are truly sorry for what happened and completely understand your disappointment, especially as this was a special occasion for your mother.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you and your family again in the future, so that we can provide you with the thoughtful, seamless, and memorable experience you originally expected. ❤️

Best regards,
Sky View Restaurant
